blocks.en: To make ReLEAF easier to monitor and operate, we developed a digital twin that connects field sensors, bioreactor measurements, and automated controls in one interface. The system tracks crop conditions alongside bioreactor data, including optical density, pH, pressure, and flow, allowing users to monitor both plant health and production status. By integrating real-time measurements with predictive monitoring, the platform helps farmers receive early warnings, track system performance, and manage ReLEAF without specialized biomanufacturing knowledge.

blocks.en: ReLEAF's bioreactor is built to stand beside a rice field and run for weeks, looked after by a rice grower with no laboratory training. The software therefore has five jobs: show what the culture is doing, raise an alarm when a reading or the culture drifts, predict the biomass a few hours ahead, judge from the weather forecast and the crop whether the protectant will be ready when it is needed, and give the answer in plain language. Live readings cover only the first job. The others need the batch simulated ahead of the vessel and the result returned to it. That return is what separates a digital twin from a digital model, which is updated by hand, and a digital shadow, which receives live data but needs a person to act on it [1, 2].

blocks.zh: ReLEAF 的生物反應器是為了立在稻田邊連續運轉數週而造的，照看它的是沒有受過實驗室訓練的稻農。因此軟體有五項任務：顯示菌液正在做什麼；當某個讀值或菌液本身偏離時發出警報；預測未來數小時的生物量；由天氣預報與作物狀況判斷保護劑能否在需要時備妥；並以白話把答案講出來。即時讀值只做到第一項。其餘各項需要讓批次的模擬跑在槽體之前，再把結果送回槽體。這個送回，正是數位孿生與另兩者的分野：數位模型要靠人工更新，數位影子雖然收到即時數據，卻仍要由人去據以行動 [1, 2]。

blocks.en: ReLEAF is an AIoT system: the bioreactor's sensors and valves are wired to a board that logs every reading, a sensor beside the crop reads leaf temperature and leaf wetness, and models learn from those readings. An autoencoder trained on the healthy first 120 hours of the 434-hour run flagged a failing photometer 26.7 hours before its reading became unusable (R2). The amount of protectant cannot be read in-line; it comes from samples drawn by hand and assayed by ELISA and DNPH (section 4). So far the models have run on recorded data after each run and a person makes every decision; the next Digital Twin joins them to the live loop.

blocks.en: Leaf wetness is not itself a stress for rice. It matters because blast fungus needs a wet leaf to infect, and infection depends on how long the leaf stays wet and how warm it is, so one sensor reads both channels. The twin applies the BLASTAM rule for leaf blast [3], which counts a wet period as an infection condition when the leaf stays wet for at least 10 hours at a mean of 22 to 25 °C, asks for longer as it gets cooler, and allows no infection below 15 °C or above 25 °C [4]; a dry hour ends the period. Hours already past come from the sensor, and hours ahead are estimated from the forecast, counted as wet when relative humidity reaches 90% [5]. When a period meets the rule, the interface tells the grower to look for lesions five to ten days later.
blocks.text: Leaf wetness is not itself a stress for rice. It matters because blast fungus needs a wet leaf to infect, and infection depends on how long the leaf stays wet and how warm it is, so one sensor reads both channels. The twin applies the BLASTAM rule for leaf blast [3], which counts a wet period as an infection condition when the leaf stays wet for at least 10 hours at a mean of 22 to 25 °C, asks for longer as it gets cooler, and allows no infection below 15 °C or above 25 °C [4]; a dry hour ends the period. Hours already past come from the sensor, and hours ahead are estimated from the forecast, counted as wet when relative humidity reaches 90% [5]. When a period meets the rule, the interface tells the grower to look for lesions five to ten days later.
blocks.zh: 葉片濕潤度本身對水稻並不是一種逆境。它之所以重要，是因為稻熱病菌需要濕的葉面才能感染，而感染與葉面維持濕潤的時間長短及當時的溫度有關，所以同一顆感測器讀這兩個通道。孿生採用葉稻熱病的 BLASTAM 規則 [3]：當葉面在平均 22 至 25 °C 下維持濕潤至少 10 小時，就把這段濕潤期算成一次感染條件；溫度越低，所需時間越長；低於 15 °C 或高於 25 °C 則不容許感染 [4]；只要出現一個乾燥小時，這段濕潤期就結束。已經過去的小時由感測器提供，未來的小時則由預報推估，相對濕度達到 90% 即算為濕 [5]。一旦某段濕潤期符合規則，介面會告知農友在五到十天後查看病斑。

blocks.en: Run 7 is the longest clean run: 77 hours in one file, OD to 3.34, no window lost to low signal. Two changes made it possible. Run 5's reading broke down after ten hours, with bubbles in a sixth of its windows and the reference drifting 4.8-fold, so run 6 halved the permeate flow to 12 mL/min and added an acceptance gate that holds the last good value when a window fails its checks. Run 5's reading broke down after ten hours, with bubbles in a sixth of its windows and the reference drifting 4.8-fold, so run 6 halved the permeate flow to 12 mL/min and added an acceptance gate that holds the last good value when a window fails its checks. Run 6 then read cleanly to 2.71 at 37 h before its sample beam was lost; run 7 passed that point at 44 h and kept reading.
blocks.zh: 第 7 次運轉是最長的一次乾淨運轉：單一檔案 77 小時，OD 升到 3.34，沒有任何視窗因訊號過低而損失。兩項改動讓這件事成為可能。第 5 次運轉的讀值在十小時後崩壞，六分之一的視窗裡有氣泡，參考訊號漂移達 4.8 倍，所以第 6 次把透過液流量減半到 12 mL/min，並加入一道驗收門檻：當某個視窗未通過檢查時，就維持最後一個良好值。第 6 次運轉隨後乾淨地讀到 37 h 的 2.71，之後失去樣品光束；第 7 次運轉在 44 h 通過那個點，並持續讀取。

blocks.en: The twin times induction from both ends. From the field, the forecast and the crop-stress rule give the hour the crop comes under stress, and the light must come on earlier by the time protectant takes to make. From the vessel, the prior sets a target time at hour zero, the Kalman filter updates it, the sensor alarm decides which readings to trust, and the fouling trace shows whether the membrane will still pass permeate. If the culture is ready in time, the twin names the hour to induce; if not, it warns days ahead that the batch cannot meet the demand.

blocks.zh: 孿生從兩端一起推算誘導的時間。從田間這端，預報與作物逆境規則給出作物進入逆境的那個小時，而綠燈必須提前，提前的量就是製造保護劑所需的時間。從槽體這端，先驗在第零小時定出一個目標時間，卡爾曼濾波器隨後更新它，感測器警報決定哪些讀值可信，積垢曲線則顯示薄膜是否還能讓透過液通過。如果菌液來得及備妥，孿生就指出該誘導的那個小時；如果來不及，它會提前數天警告這一批無法滿足需求。

attrs.en: Seven panels of OD600 against time: run 1 and run 2 hand-sampled against a shake flask, run 3 over 434 hours in-line, run 4 in two logged parts with a 10-hour unlogged gap, run 5 breaking down after ten hours, run 6 rising cleanly over 42 hours with a fitted growth rate, and run 7 across the full width, rising over 77 hours to an optical density of 3.3 with the reading intact.
attrs.zh: 七格 OD600 對時間的圖：第 1 與第 2 次運轉為人工取樣並與搖瓶對照，第 3 次為 434 小時的線上量測，第 4 次分成兩段紀錄、中間有 10 小時未記錄的空缺，第 5 次在十小時後崩壞，第 6 次在 42 小時內乾淨上升並附擬合的生長速率，第 7 次佔滿整個寬度，在 77 小時內升到光密度 3.3 且讀值完好。

attrs.en: Results
attrs.zh: 結果

attrs.en: R1 Photometer calibration
attrs.zh: R1 光度計校正

attrs.en: In-line photometer and BioDrop readings against cumulative TiO2 dose from 2 to 60 mg, each with a fitted straight line and its R squared.
attrs.zh: 線上光度計與 BioDrop 的讀值對 2 至 60 mg 的累積 TiO2 劑量，各附一條擬合直線及其 R 平方。

attrs.en: A student in a lab coat adds TiO2 suspension by syringe to a stirred bottle of white liquid that is pumped through the black in-line photometer on the desk, while an instructor watches from the side.
attrs.zh: 一位穿實驗衣的學生以針筒把 TiO2 懸浮液加進一瓶攪拌中的白色液體，液體被泵送通過桌上黑色的線上光度計，一位指導老師在旁觀看。

attrs.en: Both in-line photometer builds and the BioDrop against cumulative SiO2 dose from 2.5 to 100 mg, each with a fitted straight line and its R squared.
attrs.zh: 兩種線上光度計版本與 BioDrop 的讀值對 2.5 至 100 mg 的累積 SiO2 劑量，各附一條擬合直線及其 R 平方。

attrs.en: A student in a lab coat pipettes a sample into a cuvette beside the black in-line photometer and its stirred beaker, while an instructor logs the readings on a laptop.
attrs.zh: 一位穿實驗衣的學生把樣品吸入比色管中，旁邊是黑色的線上光度計與它的攪拌燒杯，一位指導老師在筆電上記錄讀值。

attrs.en: R2 434-hour run
attrs.zh: R2 434 小時運轉

attrs.en: OD600 and the photometer reference channel over the 434-hour batch, with the process event and instrument event shaded and the sensor alarm marked.
attrs.zh: 434 小時批次中的 OD600 與光度計參考通道，製程事件與儀器事件以網底標示，並標出感測器警報。

attrs.en: R3 Field sensors
attrs.zh: R3 田間感測器

attrs.en: The bench rig on a desk: a breadboard carrying the SHT31, an ESP32 on its expansion board, a red RS485 converter, and the white disc of the leaf sensor on its cable, with the logging laptop behind.
attrs.zh: 桌上的實驗檯裝置：一塊麵包板上接著 SHT31、裝在擴充板上的 ESP32、一個紅色 RS485 轉換器，以及連著纜線的白色圓盤狀葉片感測器，後方是記錄用的筆電。

attrs.en: Wiring diagram: the ESP32 drives a TTL to RS485 converter on GPIO17 and GPIO16, which carries A and B to the leaf sensor, while the SHT31 sits on the I2C pins GPIO21 and GPIO22. Sensor power is taken from 5 V or a 12 V adapter depending on the spec card.
attrs.zh: 接線圖：ESP32 以 GPIO17 與 GPIO16 驅動一個 TTL 轉 RS485 轉換器，由它把 A 與 B 接到葉片感測器，而 SHT31 則接在 I2C 腳位 GPIO21 與 GPIO22 上。感測器電源依規格卡而定，取自 5 V 或 12 V 轉接器。

attrs.en: Leaf minus air temperature for nine bench runs. The incubator sits near plus 1.8 degrees and the stairwell near plus 1.3; the room starts below zero and climbs past plus 1 across its three runs. A side panel gives the mean of each run against its site mean.
attrs.zh: 九次實驗檯量測的葉溫減氣溫。培養箱約在 +1.8 度，樓梯間約在 +1.3 度；室內那組由零度以下起算，在三次量測中爬升到超過 +1。側欄列出每一次量測的平均值對其地點平均值。

attrs.en: R4 Module pressure drop
attrs.zh: R4 模組壓力降

attrs.en: Pressure drop against flow, with the module fitted and with a jumper only, each fitted through the origin, and the net-module difference curve.
attrs.zh: 壓力降對流量，分別為裝上模組與只接一段跨接管的情況，各自過原點擬合，另有模組淨差值曲線。

attrs.en: R5 Batch forecasting
attrs.zh: R5 批次預報

attrs.en: Hourly medians of in-line OD600 across the 102-hour run, with a straight line and an exponential fitted to them and the two operator interventions marked.
attrs.zh: 102 小時運轉中線上 OD600 的每小時中位數，並對其擬合一條直線與一條指數曲線，兩次操作者介入也已標出。

attrs.en: R6 Light plate
attrs.zh: R6 光照板

attrs.en: Logistic growth fit to the 19 September LPA run, with the six light arms and the pooled curve.
attrs.zh: 對 9 月 19 日 LPA 量測所做的邏輯斯生長擬合，含六個光照組與合併曲線。

attrs.en: The light-programmable array running inside an incubator: a white block of capped culture tubes glowing green and red from the LEDs beneath, mounted on a black base on a shaker.
attrs.zh: 光照板裝置在培養箱內運轉：一塊白色模塊上插著加蓋的培養管，下方 LED 透出綠光與紅光，整組裝在搖床上的黑色底座上。

attrs.en: The two digital twins
attrs.zh: 兩套數位孿生

attrs.en: The bioreactor inside an incubator with its door open: a stirred bottle of amber culture, tubing, the black in-line photometer and wiring, with a peristaltic pump and a laptop showing the dashboard on top.
attrs.zh: 門打開的培養箱內的生物反應器：一瓶攪拌中的琥珀色菌液、管路、黑色的線上光度計與線材，上方是一台蠕動幫浦與一台顯示儀表板的筆電。

attrs.en: A laptop screen showing the Digital Twin dashboard: the optical density and pH charts, the four pressure traces, the membrane filtration warnings and the pump and feed valve controls.
attrs.zh: 筆電畫面顯示數位孿生儀表板：光密度與 pH 圖表、四條壓力曲線、膜過濾警告，以及幫浦與進料閥控制。

attrs.en: The System map tab of the next Digital Twin: a flow diagram of the reservoir, pumps, pinch valve and hollow-fibre module with live pressure, pH, flow and optical density readings on demo data.
attrs.zh: 下一代數位孿生的系統圖分頁：儲液槽、幫浦、夾管閥與中空纖維模組的流程圖，並以示範數據顯示即時的壓力、pH、流量與光密度讀值。

attrs.en: The Ask tab of the next Digital Twin: a chat box with example questions on the left, and on the right a panel to choose an AI provider and model and paste an API key.
attrs.zh: 下一代數位孿生的 Ask 分頁：左側是帶有範例問題的對話框，右側是選擇 AI 服務商與模型、並貼上 API 金鑰的面板。
